title: Rust toolchain, unsafe policy and native allow-list gates
narrative: As a tech lead, I want CI to enforce Rust-only first-party code, documented unsafe and an approved native-library list.

evals.name: native allow-list incl. build-script links
evals.command: cargo deny check && scripts/ci/ffi-allowlist.sh deny.native.toml --link-audit rustc-link-lib,readelf --negative-fixture tests/fixtures/unlisted-native --require owner,purpose,licence,version,reviewed
